title: SlamToolboxQuality
description: Localization quality from slam_toolbox: a pose sample with covariance on the polling interval, plus a Record on every loop closure

event.description: What this Record is: a periodic pose sample, or a loop closure occurrence

x.description: Robot x position in the pose topic's frame, metres

y.description: Robot y position in the pose topic's frame, metres

yaw.description: Robot heading in the pose topic's frame, radians

covariance_x.description: Pose covariance diagonal term for x, metres squared. Localization confidence: higher is less certain

covariance_y.description: Pose covariance diagonal term for y, metres squared

covariance_yaw.description: Pose covariance diagonal term for yaw, radians squared
